stemMarkdown: If 27 men can build a wall in 21 days, how many days will 36 men take to build the same wall, working at the same rate? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: The wall needs $27 \times 21 = 567$ man-days of effort regardless of who does it. With 36 men that is $\dfrac{567}{36} = 15.75$ days.
